scope_limitation: Feasibility slice only: 13 items across three represented domains, heavily concentrated in textile (10/13), with no semiconductor item; not a powered retrieval evaluation.

models.verifier_rule: kept only when BOTH cross-family verifiers keep

selection_rule: content-blind deterministic freeze: stable sort on (domain, question), per-domain cap 13, total cap 50; rule fixed before inspecting any candidate
discovery: bridge pairs are discovered from corpus passage text only (discover_bridge_pairs_textonly.py, inside the gold_v2 no-KG-imports CI boundary); the KG is never read at any stage
non_circularity_guarantee: The gold labels are decided solely from raw corpus passage text, a text-only bridge discovery, and a dual cross-family non-extraction verifier panel. The proposed KG (its nodes, edges, and source_docs) is never imported or referenced anywhere in the gold-build pipeline (statically enforced by test_no_kg_imports), including bridge-pair discovery.
freeze_provenance: 88 audited candidates -> 14 kept by BOTH cross-family verifiers (twohop_verify_stats.json n_kept_both=14) -> the S5 relative leakage gate then removed one steel item, qa00001 (non-answer paper overlap >= answer paper on jaccard and rouge_l; see twohop_leakage_report.json, gate.per_qa) -> 13 questions entered the content-blind freeze and all 13 were released.
release_scope: Released: the 13 frozen two-hop questions with answers, bridge/evidence fields, dual-verifier audit trail, and leakage-gate report. Source passage text is EXCLUDED because per-paper redistribution rights could not be verified; see DATA_LICENSES.md and README.
